_about: RATIFIED Company Standard — NDA document type. OWNER DESIGNATION 2026-08-19:
the executed NDA of 17 June 2026 IS the LeapSwitch NDA, i.e. the positions
LeapSwitch accepts AS RECEIVING PARTY. Under the manager's whatever-is-stated
rule those accepted positions are the baseline for reviewing counterparty NDAs
(where LeapSwitch is again the receiving party).
DIRECTION CAVEAT, recorded once: this document states LeapSwitch's
RECEIVING-party positions. If a review ever concerns LeapSwitch DISCLOSING its
own information, these standards do not state that position.
CONFIDENTIALITY: the source is executed with a real counterparty. Cite the
document only as above; never name the counterparty or signatories anywhere.

evaluation_rules._note: presence is established by the mapping layer alone (45D); the evaluator reads no clause text

_terminology: Mapping and extraction terminology, added 2026-08-19 under the owner's
publishability tasking (AUTO_MODE_DECISIONS.md #18-#21). Every term is drawn
from the cited source clause's own wording or names the clause type
generically; no term encodes a legal position (rules 7/21 - positions live
in `configuration`, sourced above). confirm_threshold 5 is STRUCTURAL: one
exact phrase confirms, or a section heading plus a keyword group. Locked
35.9 fixes no threshold and 35.10 requires calibration against a
representative contract set before the value is trusted; recalibration is a
new mapping rule version (data), never a code change.
COUNTERPARTY CALIBRATION, 2026-08-21 (locked 35.10; owner tasking to
calibrate against public sources). This PRESENCE Requirement had never been
counterparty-calibrated - the 2026-08-20 pass covered the liability and
numeric clauses only. A public SEC EDGAR NDA exhibit exposed the gap:
"governed by and construed AND ENFORCED in accordance with" missed the
configured exact phrase, and "legally compelled ... to disclose" and
"destroy all Confidential Information" missed theirs. Added terms are
generic drafting synonyms only; no position, threshold or expected_presence
was touched (rules 7/21). Each scores 3 against confirm_threshold 5, so two
independent signals remain required.
WITHDRAWN SAME DAY, 2026-08-21: the keyword group `disclose + notice` was
added in this pass and immediately matched the IT Act 2000 in the negative
sweep - two ordinary words that co-occur in any statute about disclosure.
Removed. The public EDGAR specimen is carried by `legally compelled` plus
the `compelled + disclose` group, which are keyed to the clause type rather
than to the vocabulary of disclosure in general.
_legal_rule_note: APPROVED ZERO-TOLERANCE LEGAL RULE (manager ruling 2026-08-19; owner
approval to wire, 2026-08-20). MATCH -> ACCEPTABLE (no decision needed);
ANY deviation -- unlimited included -> UNACCEPTABLE -> Legal Decision
required; nothing that differs is ever auto-approved. There are
deliberately NO thresholds and NO tolerance bands: do not add
acceptable_max or approval_required_above, and do not ask for them --
the policy is that none exists. Wired as deviation_outcome +
unlimited_outcome, both read by the evaluators; an unrecognised value
fails closed to NOT_APPLICABLE and a human (ENG-09, Step 20 r4).
